NIFTY POSTS BIGGEST 4‑WEEK RALLY IN SIX YEARS

Nifty posted its biggest 4‑week rally in six years, rising over 14% in a month, while Bank Nifty hit a record high.
The rally was driven by gains in large‑cap banks and auto and healthcare stocks such as SBI, Maruti Suzuki and Max Healthcare, while mid‑and small‑caps lagged.
